items.name: Table
items.summary: A table's records, fields and comments. Writes of more than 10 records go 10 at a time.

members.name: fields
members.summary: The table's fields (schema).

members.name: select
members.summary: A query over the table's records: `.all()`, `.firstPage()`, `.eachPage()` or `for await`.

members.name: find
members.summary: One record by id.

members.name: create
signatures: create(records: { fields: Partial<F> }[], options?: WriteOptions): Promise<OpenRowsRecord<F>[]>
members.summary:
Creates one record from its cells.

Creates records, in order, 10 per request.

members.name: update
signatures: update(recordId: string, fields: Partial<F>, options?: WriteOptions): Promise<OpenRowsRecord<F>>
members.summary:
Changes the cells given of one record; the others stay.

Changes the cells given of each record, 10 per request.

members.name: replace
signatures: replace(recordId: string, fields: Partial<F>, options?: WriteOptions): Promise<OpenRowsRecord<F>>
members.summary:
Replaces one record's cells: fields left out are cleared.

Replaces each record's cells, 10 per request.

members.name: upsert
signatures: upsert(records: { id?: string; fields: Partial<F> }[], options: UpsertOptions & { replace?: boolean }): Promise<UpsertResult<F>>
members.summary:
Updates the records that match on `fieldsToMergeOn` (or have an `id`) and creates the rest,
10 per request. With `replace`, the fields left out of a matched record are cleared.

members.name: destroy
members.summary:
Moves one record to the trash.

Moves records to the trash, 10 per request.

members.name: comments
members.summary: A record's comments.

items.name: Query
items.summary:
A list of records, fetched a page at a time (at most 100 records each; `pageSize` and
`maxRecords` narrow it).

members.name: firstPage
members.summary: The first page of records.

members.name: eachPage
members.summary: Calls `onPage` with each page in turn; answering `false` stops.

members.name: all
members.summary: Every record, all pages.

members.name: [asyncIterator]
members.summary: `for await (const record of table.select())`: one page in memory at a time.

items.name: Comments
items.summary: A record's comments: `table.comments(recordId)`.

members.name: page

members.summary: One page of comments, newest first.

members.name: all
members.summary: Every comment, newest first.

members.name: create
members.summary: Posts a comment (`@[Name](user:<id>)` mentions someone).

items.name: Webhooks
items.summary: A base's webhooks.

members.name: list
members.summary: The base's webhooks (never their secrets).

members.name: create
members.summary: Creates a webhook; the answer's `secret` is shown only this once.

members.name: update
members.summary: Changes, enables or disables a webhook; `{ rotateSecret: true }` answers a new `secret`.

members.name: delete
members.summary: Deletes a webhook and its delivery log.

members.name: deliveries
signatures: deliveries(webhookId: string, options?: { limit?: number }): Promise<WebhookDelivery[]>
members.summary: The webhook's delivery attempts of the last 7 days, newest first.

members.name: ping
members.summary: Sends a signed `ping` now and answers with the attempt.

members.name: redeliver
signatures: redeliver(webhookId: string, deliveryId: string): Promise<{ queued: true; eventId: string }>
members.summary:
Queues a logged delivery's event again, with the same event id; the attempt shows in
`deliveries` once the worker sent it. Not for pings, nor while the webhook is off (409).

items.name: Automations
items.summary: A base's automations: built in the app, listed, switched and triggered here.

members.name: list
members.summary: The base's automations.

members.name: get
members.summary: One automation.

members.name: setEnabled
members.summary: Turns an automation on (it then runs as you) or off.

members.name: runs
signatures: runs(automationId: string, options?: { limit?: number; status?: "succeeded" | "failed" | "skipped" }): Promise<{ id: string; automationId: string; status: "succeeded" | "failed" | "skipped"; mode: "live" | "test" | "retry"; skipReason: "loop" | "quota" | null; retryOf: string | null; trigger: unknown; steps: { index: number; type: "createRecord" | "updateRecord" | "findRecords" | "sendEmail" | "httpRequest" | "slackMessage" | "runScript"; status: "succeeded" | "failed" | "skipped"; input: unknown; output: unknown; error: string | null; durationMs: number }[]; error: string | null; depth: number; triggeredBy: string | null; durationMs: number; createdAt: string }[]>
members.summary: The automation's runs of the last 30 days, newest first.

members.name: trigger
signatures: trigger(automationId: string, input?: { body?: unknown; recordId?: string }): Promise<V1AutomationsTriggerResponse>
members.summary:
Triggers a webhook-received automation with `{ body }` (any JSON, as if POSTed to its URL)
or a button-clicked one with `{ recordId }` (a click on that record's button, as you).

items.name: OpenRowsError
items.summary:
The server refused a request. `type` is Airtable's error type where one fits (`NOT_FOUND`,
`INVALID_PERMISSIONS`, `INVALID_FILTER_BY_FORMULA`, `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS`), `code` OpenRows'
stable code, `requestId` the id to quote when reporting a problem (also in the server's logs).

members.name: errors
members.summary: What failed validation, for a 422.

members.name: limit
members.summary: For a 429: the bucket that ran out (`base`, `token` or `user`).

members.name: retryAfter
members.summary: For a 429: seconds the server asked to wait (`Retry-After`).

members.name: request
members.summary: The request that failed, like `GET /api/v1/<base>/Tasks`.

members.name: constructor
signatures: new OpenRowsError(init: { status: number; type: string; code: string; message: string; requestId: string | null; request: string; errors?: OpenRowsErrorDetail[]; limit?: string | null; retryAfter?: number | null })

items.name: chunks
items.summary: `items` in slices of at most `size`.
signatures: chunks<T>(items: readonly T[], size?: number): T[][]

items.name: isOpenRowsError
items.summary: Whether `error` is an `OpenRowsError` (also across copies of the SDK in one bundle).

members.name: list
members.summary: Every base the token (and its owner) can read, with the permission level.

items.name: Fields
items.summary: A table's fields (the `schema.bases:write` scope and the creator role).

members.name: create
members.summary: Adds a field; `type` is ours or Airtable's name for it.

members.name: update
members.summary: Renames a field or changes its description.

items.name: OpenRowsErrorDetail
items.summary: One problem with the request, as the server names it (`path` is like `records.0.fields`).

members.name: apiKey
members.summary: A personal access token (`or_pat_…`). Leave it out in a browser signed in to the same app.

members.name: baseUrl
members.summary: The app's origin, e.g. `https://app.openrows.io` (the default) or your own server's.

members.name: maxRetries
members.summary: How many times to retry a request answered 429, after its `Retry-After` (default 3).

members.name: maxRetryDelay
members.summary: The longest `Retry-After` to wait, in ms; a longer one fails at once (default 60 s).

members.name: timeout
members.summary: Per-request timeout in ms (default 60 s; 0 for none).

members.name: fetch
members.summary: A `fetch` to use instead of the global one.

members.name: headers
members.summary: Extra headers sent with every request.
